name: Albariq Equipment
eyebrow: Home services · Dubai Investment Park, Dubai
headline: Cleaning Equipment Supplier in the UAE, Saudi Arabia & Qatar
lede: Cleaning equipment and machinery in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Qatar: scrubber dryers, sweepers, vacuums and washers, with 7 service centres and 15,000+ parts.
about: For more than 30 years ALBARIQ has supplied cleaning and floor-preparation equipment from more than 20 manufacturers, selected to match your project requirements and budget. We are the authorised distributor in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Qatar for many of them, including Duplex, FactoryCat, FIMAP, PowerBoss, Santoemma, Timberline and TTS.

Walk-behind and ride-on scrubber dryers, sweepers, vacuum cleaners, pressure washers, single-disc machines, carpet extractors and cleaning robots for facilities management companies and cleaning contractors. Buy or rent, with service from our own centres.
